from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A party identified in the judgment document."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the party as written in the document")
    role: str | None = Field(description="Role in the case (e.g., 上诉人，被上诉人，申请人，被申请人)")

class Fee(BaseModel):
    """A fee or cost item mentioned in the judgment."""
    amount: str | None = Field(description="The fee amount as written, including currency if applicable")
    payer: str | None = Field(description="Who bears the cost (e.g., 上诉人，被上诉人，共同负担)")
    type: str | None = Field(description="Type of fee (e.g., 二审受理费，保全费)")

class CaseMatchInfo(BaseModel):
    """Core matching information extracted from a judgment document."""
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="Case number (e.g., (2023) 京 04 执恢 20 号)")
    court_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the court issuing the judgment")
    cause: str | None = Field(description="Cause of action (案由)")
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="List of parties involved in the case")
    outcome_summary: list[str] = Field(description="The core ruling text (e.g., 驳回上诉，维持原判)")
    fees: list[Fee] = Field(description="List of fees assessed in the judgment")
    disputed_amounts: list[str] = Field(description="Specific monetary amounts in dispute or awarded")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of legal document (e.g., 民事判决书，行政裁定书)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregated evidence for the single document being parsed."""
    cases: list[CaseMatchInfo]
